sources.excerpt: The 2026 AFL Grand Final was an Australian rules football match that was contested between the Fremantle Football Club and the Brisbane Lions at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Saturday, 26 September 2026.

It was the 131st annual grand final of the Australian Football League, staged to determine the premiers of the 2026 AFL season. Brisbane won by a margin of seven points, marking the club's sixth premiership overall, and third consecutive premiership.

The Norm Smith Medal was won by Fremantle midfielder Shai Bolton, polling 10 of a possible 15 votes. He became the fifth player to win the medal in a losing team, and the first since Chris Judd in 2005.

In tennis, Ukraine reaches its first Billie Jean King Cup final after defeating defending champion Italy 2–0 in the semifinals, with Elina Svitolina securing the decisive victory over Jasmine Paolini.
Italy were the two-time defending champions, but they lost to Ukraine in the semifinals.
The event will be held in Shenzhen, China on 22–27 September 2026.
The United States and China reach an agreement to cut tariffs on $30 billion of goods and launch a dialogue on artificial intelligence.
Both sides agreed to establish a China-US artificial intelligence dialogue to exchange views on the risks and benefits of AI. The next dialogue will be held in November this year.
Researchers at the University of British Columbia have identified two previously unknown species of sea spider, including one with hairy legs and striking red eyes.
The discoveries mark the first new sea spider species formally described from the Salish Sea in nearly 100 years.

Sea spiders belong to an ancient lineage that arose roughly 500 million years ago. They are related to spiders, scorpions, and horseshoe crabs, but unlike their land-dwelling relatives, they remained entirely marine.
